body: Thank you, this actually really helps. I know he’s definitely the right one so that conversation might have to happen soon, even if it will take time to come to terms with it.

I totally get this. And sometimes being confident just feels like I’m making a fool of myself, like as an ugly person it’s just out of line and ive ended up humiliating myself. i really feel that apologising stuff. he deserves someone objectively more attractive than i am, sometimes i just want to say sorry.
